# GhostESP Documentation

> GhostESP is an open-source Wi-Fi and multi-protocol wireless security platform for ESP32 devices. This site documents flashing, the on-device UI, the WebUI, the serial CLI, and every wireless feature.

Documentation base URL: /
Firmware versions documented: latest, v2.1, v1.9.9, v1.9.8, v1.9.3, v1.9, v1.8.1, v1.8

## For AI agents and tooling

- Site-wide search index (JSON, compact, all versions): /search-index.json
- Per-version search index (JSON, includes full page text): e.g. /latest/search-index.json
- Per-page plain text: append `index.txt` to any docs URL, e.g. /latest/wifi/deauth/index.txt
- Human, URL-addressable search page: /search/?q=your+query
- Sitemap: /sitemap.xml

Each search-index record contains: id, url, version, section, title, description, keywords, summary, headings (with anchors), lastmod, and text_url.

## Agent quick start (prompt)

Copy the block below into your agent/bot. Replace DOCS_URL with this site's origin.

```
You are a GhostESP documentation assistant. Answer only from the docs.

Finding pages (do not guess URLs):
1. Fetch DOCS_URL/search-index.json once and cache it. It is a JSON array covering
   every page in every firmware version.
2. Each record: title, description, keywords[], summary, section,
   headings[{id,title,level}], url, version, text_url.
3. Rank candidates by the user's question against title, then keywords, then
   headings[].title, then description/summary. Prefer version "latest" unless the
   user names a version.
4. Read the best record as clean text by fetching its text_url
   (for example DOCS_URL/latest/wifi/deauth/index.txt). That is the full page with
   headings and links, and costs far fewer tokens than the HTML page.
5. If you need a narrower slice, search within the per-version index that includes
   full text: DOCS_URL/latest/search-index.json.

Answering:
- Cite the exact url. When you used a specific section, link its anchor:
  url#<heading id> (ids are in the record's headings[]).
- Quote commands and menu paths exactly as they appear in the fetched text.
- If nothing matches, say so and link DOCS_URL/search/?q=<terms>.
- Never invent commands, menu paths, or settings.

Useful URL patterns:
- Human, linkable search: DOCS_URL/search/?q=deauth&version=latest
- Plain text for any page: <page url>index.txt
- Full page map: DOCS_URL/llms.txt
```

## Documentation


### latest

- [Camera Stream](/latest/camera/camera-stream/): Live MJPEG camera stream viewable in a browser via the GhostESP web interface.

- [Capturing handshakes](/v1.8/wifi/handshakes/): Record Wi-Fi authentication data for analysis.
- [Dual Communication](/v1.8/getting-started/dual-communication/): Connect two ESP32 devices to control one remotely while maintaining continuous AP hosting.
- [Infrared Files](/v1.8/infrared/files/): Organize, rename, and edit GhostESP IR files
- [Writing NTAG](/v1.8/nfc/writing/): Program NTAG and Ultralight cards from saved dumps
- [WebUI](/v1.8/getting-started/webui-guide/): Access and control GhostESP through the web interface.
- [Evil Portal](/v1.8/wifi/evil-portal/): Host a fake Wi-Fi login page to test security awareness.
- [FAQ](/v1.8/getting-started/faq/): Frequently asked questions about GhostESP setup, credentials, and troubleshooting.
- [Hardware Support](/v1.8/infrared/hardware/): Boards and peripherals required for GhostESP infrared
- [Supported Tags](/v1.8/nfc/supported/): Reference for NFC tag support in GhostESP
- [Karma Attack](/v1.8/wifi/karma/): Automatically respond to device probes with fake networks.
